description: Angular component for user profile management, including form handling, user data loading, and saving updates.

classes.name: ProfileComponent
classes.description: Angular component for user profile page, handling user data display and update.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the component, builds the profile form, and loads user data.

methods.name: buildProfileForm
methods.description: Creates the reactive form for user profile editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the updated user profile data to the server and updates application state.

methods.name: userLoaded
methods.description: Populates the form with user data and initializes form fields based on user info.

methods.name: confirmForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for confirmation guard.

methods.name: isSysAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the current user has SYS_ADMIN authority.
